information_flow: The first call receives all common inputs and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule and reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract; evidenced contract incompatibility changes the active lineage basis to anchor_policy while preserving one complete executable state. The third consumes that state and reopens only task_constraints and loop_structure. The final call consumes the resulting closure, reopens only task and candidate_hypothesis, and emits one policy.
name: Triggered Causal Re-root Relay
organization: four-call sequential nonbranching executable lineage with contract-triggered causal re-root authority on the anchor-window edge

calls.objective: Reconcile the visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, assess its causal basis against only the reentered anchor evidence, apply the contract-triggered lineage re-root transition when evidenced, and emit one complete executable policy state.
Consume anchor_causal_reroot_transition, reconcile the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered constraints and structural evidence, and emit one complete executable policy closure.
Consume constraint_window_transition, reconcile the inherited complete artifact against only the reentered task and hypothesis evidence, and emit one complete policy.
